definitions.explanation: The quality of being able to continue or last over time. Used for the lasting power of effects, products, systems, or practices.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持続性|じぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持続性|じぞくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Development that considers environmental sustainability is being called for.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦モデル→モデル：05112_moderu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{持続性|じぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{長期的|ちょうきてき}→長期的：20406_choukiteki⟧な⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}する→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to examine from a long-term perspective whether this business model is sustainable.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{持続|じぞく}→持続：12813_jizoku⟧ (continuation, persistence) and ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (nature, quality). This word has become increasingly prominent in discussions about sustainability and the environment, though it also has broader applications.

USAGE:
- Often used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: {持続性|じぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (is sustainable/durable), {持続性|じぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (is not sustainable)
- Used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ to describe degree
- Common in environmental, business, and scientific contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {持続性|じぞくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: sustainable, lasting
- {持続性|じぞくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly durable/persistent
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持続性|じぞくせい}: environmental sustainability
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{持続性|じぞくせい}: economic sustainability
- {持続性|じぞくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to improve sustainability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{持続|じぞく}→持続：12813_jizoku⟧⟦{可能|かのう}{性|せい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧: sustainability (literally "possibility of continuation") — the specific environmental/development term, often translating English "sustainability"
- ⟦{耐久性|たいきゅうせい}→耐久性：20042_taikyuusei⟧: durability — focuses on physical toughness and resistance to wear
- {継続性|けいぞくせい}: continuity — focuses on unbroken continuation rather than lasting quality
